title: Coherence of outputwise operadic mapping comparisons
statement: Use the quasicategories, mapping spaces, symmetric infinity-operads, and transport frames of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], [lem-coef-relative-operadic-terminal-active-mapping], and [def-coef-colored-operator-systems]. Let $O$ be a small ordinary symmetric colored operad, allowing nullary operations, and let $B=N(O^\otimes)$ be its operator nerve, with finite tuples of colors as objects and an operation for each non-basepoint output of an arrow. Let $q:E^\otimes\to B$ be a cocartesian fibration and a map of symmetric infinity-operads. Suppose actual inert projection transports identify every tuple fiber $E_{\mathbf c}$ with $\prod_i E_{c_i}$, including the empty tuple. Fix a coherent transport frame, with operation transports $T_\theta$ and their cocartesian lift triangles. For an operator $f:\mathbf c\to\mathbf d$ and $X\in E_{\mathbf c}$, $Y\in E_{\mathbf d}$, let $M_f(X,Y)=\operatorname{hofib}_f(\operatorname{Map}_{E^\otimes}(X,Y)\to\operatorname{Map}_B(\mathbf c,\mathbf d))$. Use the comparison of [lem-coef-relative-operadic-output-mapping] from this space to the product, over outputs $j$, of $\operatorname{Map}_{E_{d_j}}(T_{\theta_j}((x_i)_{f(i)=j}),y_j)$, where $x_i,y_j$ are the inert projections of $X,Y$ and $\theta_j$ is the output operation of $f$. The outputwise comparisons are natural under restriction to an output and under coherent parameters in $X$ and $Y$. For composable operators $f:\mathbf c\to\mathbf d$ and $g:\mathbf d\to\mathbf e$, the comparison for $g\circ f$ identifies total composition in $M_f$ and $M_g$ with outputwise substitution of the corresponding operation arrows, using the composition triangles of the transport frame. These identifications include all higher simplices and are compatible with further substitution, identities, permutations, nullary input blocks, and the empty target product. Thus the comparisons form one complete coherent comparison system, rather than unrelated equivalences of individual mapping spaces; no limits or colimits in color fibers are used.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Construction 2.1.1.7, Definition 2.1.1.10(2), Proposition 2.1.2.22 and Remark 2.1.3.4; naturality and substitution-coherence clause of the relative operadic Segal mapping calculation. Read online; WANTED archive in literature/. No Stacks tag states this infinity-operadic assertion.
